name: Drydock
description: What a Drydock workspace needs inside its container: Claude Code at a pinned version, configured on Drydock's shared credential volume and checked fit for a headless Remote Control session; GitHub access through the per-workspace token broker (a git credential helper and a gh shim), the agent's commit identity, and the drydock/ branch guard; and the repository secrets granted to it, delivered before every command through CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.

claudeCodeVersion.description: The exact Claude Code version to install, X.Y.Z — never latest or stable. Pinned because Drydock scrapes its terminal output and depends on undocumented internals of one version (design §11); Drydock passes the version it was built against.

botName.description: git user.name for commits made in the workspace: the GitHub App's bot, e.g. krelinga-drydock[bot]. Empty leaves it unset.

botEmail.description: git user.email: <bot-user-id>+<app-slug>[bot]@users.noreply.github.com, where the number is the bot USER id, not the App ID (design §9.3).

branchPrefix.description: Pushes are refused outside refs/heads/<branchPrefix>. Empty disables the guard.

requireBroker.description: Fail the container's start when the broker socket does not answer. false only for testing the Feature itself.
